title: Experiment support and verification: canonical checklist and gradual backfill
summary: Accepted core backfill completed for 11 records and 26 task variants; 38 evidence records and 187 source hashes reconciled. Complete prepared bundles, environment builds, scoring and standalone recovery verified; seven deterministic cardiac transfers rerun. No new model trials.
decision_provenance: User accepted all recommendations and set the criterion: another agent can recover inputs, prepare the environment, execute and evaluate; stochastic outputs may differ. Large-data acquisition instructions with sanity checks are acceptable. Selected scope and original recommendation history are in the linked discussion.
reopen_when: A selected reuse requires a historical method, inputs are recovered, a maintained operation changes, or a new scoped verification receipt becomes available.
